description.en: The root path of the API.

description.zh: 关联的标签列表，多个用逗号（,）分隔
description.en: A list of associated tags. Separate multiple tags with commas (,).

description.zh: 用户自定义的配置项数据
分组描述，不超过180个字符，不传递表示不修改
description.en: The description of the API group. The description can be up to 180 characters in length. If you do not specify this parameter, the description is not modified.

description.zh: 是否过滤后端请求中的appcode
description.en: Specifies whether to filter the app code from backend requests.

description.zh: API分组ID，系统生成，全局唯一
description.en: The ID of the API group. This ID is generated by the system and is globally unique.

description.zh: 分组名称，必须唯一，支持汉字、英文字母、数字、英文格式的下划线，必须以英文字母或汉字开头，4~50个字符，不传递表示不修改
description.en: The name of the API group. The name must be unique and 4 to 50 characters in length. It must start with a letter or a Chinese character and can contain letters, digits, underscores (\_), and Chinese characters. If you do not specify this parameter, the name is not modified.

description.zh: 是否支持网关向客户端发送事件流，实现实时数据推送
description.en: Specifies whether the gateway sends event streams to clients to enable real-time data push.

description.zh: 指定规则所适用的对象标签，可设置多个。
description.en: The object tags to which the rule applies. You can specify multiple tags.

descriptions.zh:
- 此功能面向API提供者
- 该接口调用的QPS限制为：单用户QPS不超过50
descriptions.en:
- This feature is intended for API providers.

- The queries per second (QPS) limit for this operation is 50 per user.
